Our support portal will move to a new address on June 8. Your existing username will remain valid; [135] ____, you will need to create a new password at your first login. The reset link will be sent to the email address currently associated with your account.

Requests submitted before the move will remain [136] ____ in the new portal. There is no need to open a second ticket for the same issue. [137] ____

To help the transition run [138] ____, please verify your contact email by June 5. We will never ask you to send your password by email.
